designs.title: Dasara Gold Bangles
designs.idea: Dasara post and short reel for our emerald and ruby gold bangles, neatly edited, maroon and gold.
designs.caption:
This Dasara, let your festive look shine. ✨

Our handcrafted gold bangles with emeralds, rubies and sparkling white stones, made for Vijayadashami and every celebration after.

Wishing you and your family a very Happy Dasara! 🙏

DM us or WhatsApp us to order.
steps: Tap Download picture and Download reel to save both to your phone.
Instagram post: pick the picture, paste the caption, and post around 7:30 PM.
Instagram reel: pick the reel, add a trending Dasara song from Instagram's music, paste the caption, and share.
Put the reel on your WhatsApp Status and Facebook too.

designs.title: Timeless Jhumkas
designs.idea: A festive post for our 22K plain jhumkas, maroon and gold.
designs.caption:
Some designs never go out of style. Our 22K hallmarked gold jhumkas, handcrafted for every festival and every wedding. ✨

DM us on WhatsApp to order.
steps: Open it in Canva and add your jhumka photo if it isn't there yet.
Tap Share, then Download, and save it as a picture.
Post it on Instagram around 7:30 PM, and paste the caption.
Share the same picture on your WhatsApp Status and Facebook.
